verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents Teams Export APIs that export 1:1, group chat, meeting chat, and channel messages, which covers private conversations. Messages users delete stay accessible through these APIs for 21 days. The evidence does not show a workspace-wide, admin-driven export, any named machine-readable output format, or policy controls over which private conversations can be exported. Missing for 10: documented admin-scoped full-workspace export, explicit machine-readable output formats, policy-governed inclusion of private chats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows

citations.quote: Teams Export APIs allow you to export 1:1, group chat, meeting chats, and channel messages from Microsoft Teams.
Messages deleted by users from the Teams client can be accessed using export APIs up to 21 days from the time of deletion.
